title: Concept: Python requirement pinned with a wildcard
description: requirements.txt declares an `==N.*` wildcard pin, which accepts every release in that segment, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The wildcard looks like a pin but accepts unreviewed patch releases, so two builds can install different code from the same file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The wildcard looks like a pin but accepts unreviewed patch releases, so two builds can install different code from the same file.
